answer.reason: In Table 1 of the EIA Arkansas Electricity Profile 2024, net generation is broken out by sector. The IPP & CHP (independent power producer and combined-heat-and-power) category for Arkansas is about 7.16 million MWh, which matches option B. The larger figure, 54,385,955 MWh, corresponds to Arkansas's total (all-sectors) net generation; the arithmetic is consistent, since 54,385,955 − 7,156,529 = 47,229,426 MWh, a plausible electric power sector total for the state. Therefore, the IPP & CHP net generation listed is 7,156,529 megawatthours.
